name: Steal My Heart ~Rhapsody of Moonlight~
original_name: すてぃーるMyはぁと～Rhapsody of moonlight～
source:
Akitomo enjoys his peaceful school life, but one night, he met a mysterious thief and his world suddenly changed. All the unexplainable events and environment changes made him totally confused. What fate awaits him in the future?
